title: Podcast EP373: The Impact of yieldHUB Live and Details of Upcoming Show Participation with Gillian O'Donnell
gist: Promotional podcast summary: Daniel Nenni interviews yieldHUB's Gillian O'Donnell about yieldHUB Live, a real-time test-floor intelligence tool, a forthcoming customer case study, and yieldHUB's presence at ITC and Semicon West in October 2026. No hard performance numbers are given in the text.

insights.claim: yieldHUB positions itself as an enterprise yield management platform used by semiconductor and photonics manufacturers, with yieldHUB Live providing real-time insight into test floors while production is still running.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Shows demand for real-time test analytics to improve yield and tester capacity in high-volume manufacturing.
insights.quote: gives manufacturers real-time insight into their test floor while production is still running

insights.claim: yieldHUB Live is pitched as improving both yield and tester capacity on high-volume test floors.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Tester capacity utilization is a cost lever for OSATs/IDMs; software that raises it is a niche growth area.
insights.quote: as they improve yield and tester capacity

insights.claim: yieldHUB is publishing a new customer case study on yieldHUB Live results in a real production setting, though the summary gives no figures.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Watch for quantified results to validate claims.

insights.claim: yieldHUB will exhibit at ITC (October 11-16, 2026, San Antonio, booth 602) and participate in Semicon West (October 13-15, 2026, Moscone Center, San Francisco).
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Near-term event calendar for semiconductor test/equipment newsflow.
